title: OpenAI announces fresh updates for Dots just days after its launch
key_facts: OpenAI introduced Dots a few days ago: always-on agents with their own cloud computer that learn from feedback and work towards goals 24/7.
A dot can now be created in the ChatGPT mobile app on iOS and Android: name it, customise its appearance, connect plugins.
ChatGPT can open directly to the dot's conversation.
A dot can start work in Codex, follow up on existing threads, search across ChatGPT conversations and use context from Codex threads and automations.
It is better at deciding whether to continue an existing Codex thread or start a new one.
It can read and edit ChatGPT Work automations, for example review what is scheduled or update a recurring task.
quote_evidence: You can now create your dot in the ChatGPT mobile app on iOS and Android.
Your dot can start work in Codex and follow up on existing threads.
Your dot can read and edit ChatGPT Work automations, too.
why_it_matters_hint: Dots become reachable from the phone and tie in with OpenAI's coding and task agents.
event_date: Not stated; article of 10 Oct 2026, "just days after" launch
notes: Small outlet relaying OpenAI's own post; date of OpenAI's update post not stated. Our 8 Oct 2026 edition carried WIRED's test of Dots (item 105).
